    # From demonstrations, rows with notch value 0 in the left panel map to
    # the output pattern selected by parity of the row: odd rows carry notches

        out[r][12] = grid[r][12]
        out[r][13] = grid[r][13]
    return out
",

 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # Demonstration-derived per-row reconstruction:
    # Repeated panels encode 2-cell motifs; the output removes anomalous
    # isolated cell marks when they are not part of the canonical copy.
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    starts = (0, 3, 6, 9, 12)
    for r in range(len(grid)):
        motifs = [tuple(grid[r][c:c+2]) for c in starts]
        # Most common motif reproduces the repeated-symbol correction seen
        # across demos; apply it only when a clear consensus exists.
        common = max(set(motifs), key=motifs.count)
        if motifs.count(common) >= 2:
            for c in starts:
                out[r][c:c+2] = list(common)
    return out
",
 "path": "programs/task-c17168a0.py"
}
